purpose: bounded primary-source reading for dual-case hypothesis induction

sources.title: Schema Induction and Analogical Transfer
sources.authors: Mary L. Gick; Keith J. Holyoak
sources.read_scope: Part II Experiments 4–6 and General Discussion, printed pp.21–33; source PDF downloaded, OCR pp.20–33; pp.22–25 and30–31 visually checked.
sources.boundary: Human analogical transfer studies, not hypothesis correctness theorem or agent replication. Table5 two-analog combined before-hint45% vs one-analog+unrelated-story21%; do not overstate dissimilar superiority.

sources.title: Structure-Mapping: A Theoretical Framework for Analogy
sources.read_scope: Mapping rules, relational versus attribute overlap, systematicity, admitted inappropriate abstraction and correspondence-order qualifications; printed pp.155–165 and169.
sources.boundary: Candidate relational mappings, not empirical truth or guaranteed utility.

sources.title: Modern Bayesian Experimental Design
sources.authors: Tom Rainforth; Adam Foster; Desi R. Ivanova; Freddie Bickford Smith
sources.read_scope: §2 information-theoretic/adaptive design, alternative utilities, §5.3 model misspecification/downstream analysis.
sources.boundary: Review of model-based design, not evidence Hegel has calibrated VOI from two episodes.

sources.title: Selecting Computations: Theory and Applications
sources.authors: Nicholas Hay; Stuart Russell; David Tolpin; Solomon Eyal Shimony
sources.read_scope: §2 metalevel decision model, §3 context/non-indexability, §4 myopic and blinkered policy qualifications.
sources.boundary: Decision-theoretic stopping and computational cost, no per-Hegel-step positive utility guarantee; one-step estimates can stop too early.

sources.title: LILO: Learning Interpretable Libraries by Compressing and Documenting Code
sources.read_scope: §2–4.2 synthesis/compress/rewrite/AutoDoc, frozen offline search and post-hoc baseline library, appendix C.2 controlled same-program compression.
sources.boundary: Author experiments not reproduced. Program compression not empirical scientific validation; same source tasks/solved programs do not establish equal full experimental histories.

additional_source_scope: See 05_来源与核算范围.md for physics, thermodynamics, AWM and HippoRAG 2 sources.
